note: Needles for the licensing gate (app/scripts/license-gate.mjs, check 3). Each entry is the sha256 of a short AMA CPT or NUBC/UB-04 descriptor fragment, never the text itself, so this public repo carries no licensed descriptor wording. To add one: normalize the phrase as below, then add its sha256, word count and character count.
normalization: lowercase; every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 becomes one space; trim
